game.title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
game.blurb: Demon-recruiting RPG in which the Nahobino and his friends decide the fate of a dying world, from Atlus, released 2024-06-14. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The Nahobino's journey and its endings. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Negotiation, Fusion and the Compendium

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's entry at the expected slug "shin-megami-tensei-v" (id 257242) is titled "Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance" and dated 2024-06-14, so it is the Vengeance entry; RAWG also has a separate "Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Digital Deluxe Edition" entry (983580), and a RAWG search showed no separate entry for the earlier Shin Megami Tensei V. StrategyWiki has a page for Vengeance at completion stage 0 (a stub); only a short Table of Contents subpage (117 characters) exists, and its Walkthrough, Gameplay, New features and Achievements and trophies pages are linked but not written. It also links the separate "Shin Megami Tensei V" guide, whose Walkthrough is likewise not written. megamitensei.fandom.com answers the API, with about 386 linked pages, including "List of Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance Trophies", "Da'at (Shin Megami Tensei V)" and "Qadištu"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Pleiades" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1875830. 16 of 48 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Several of them (3 to 17) look like story or ending markers, and "He Who Revels in Carnage" (48, 2.0 percent) may be a post-game goal. "Purger of Memories" mentions an "Original Mode", which suggests a second story mode, but no achievement names one.
